dialogue_texts: The festival was supposed to be a breeze, but these fairies are actin' way rowdier than usual. What's the big idea?
The Scarlet Devil is mad now...
Well, look who it is. Koakuma? What's a library helper doing all the way out here in Kozankyo?
Pretty sure Flandre didn't permit ya to skip chores.
Having learned that you've taken out the Grieg twins, I think it's time for more revenge.
More revenge!? Don't blame me just 'cause you guys picked a fight you couldn't win!
Move aside; I've got a festival to enjoy and some magic to check out!
With my revenge ready, the festival will be cut short...
